instructions: Verified decision list. Find a line whose stated field conditions all match the input, then return its label. Unstated fields can have any value. Matching lines agree.
If action=export, context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, return allow.
If action=approve, context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, return allow.
If action=approve, context=internal, risk=FALSE, return allow.
If action=approve, risk=TRUE, role=operator, return allow.
If action=export, context=sandbox, role=guest, return allow.
If action=approve, context=sandbox, role=guest, return allow.
If action=approve, context=sandbox, role=operator, return allow.
If action=approve, risk=FALSE, role=operator, return allow.
If action=approve, risk=FALSE, role=auditor, return allow.
If action=export, context=external, risk=TRUE, role=operator, return allow.
If action=export, context=external, risk=FALSE, role=operator, return allow.
If action=export, context=external, risk=FALSE, role=auditor, return allow.
If action=approve, context=internal, risk=TRUE, role=guest, return allow.
If action=export, context=external, risk=UNKNOWN, return deny.
If action=approve, context=external, risk=UNKNOWN, return deny.
If action=export, context=external, role=guest, return deny.
If action=approve, context=external, role=guest, return deny.
If action=export, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, role=auditor, return deny.
If action=approve, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, role=auditor, return deny.
If action=inspect, context=sandbox, return review.
If action=inspect, context=external, return review.
If risk=TRUE, role=auditor, return review.
If action=inspect, risk=FALSE, return review.
If action=export, context=internal, risk=FALSE, return review.
If action=inspect, risk=TRUE, return review.
If action=export, context=internal, risk=TRUE, return review.
If context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return uncertain.
If action=export, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, role=operator, return uncertain.
If action=export, context=sandbox, risk=TRUE, role=operator, return uncertain.

dsl.final_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == auditor)) or (event.action == inspect)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == internal)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == sandbox) and (event.role != auditor)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when (not (Critical(event))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedApprove:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == approve)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80

rule ExportInternal:
    when (event.action == export) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule GuestExternal:
    when (event.role == guest) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule TrustedForbidDeny:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = deny

rule DefaultAllow:
    when (((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (not (Trusted(event)))) and (not ((event.role == guest) and (event.context == external)))
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when ((event.action == export) and (event.context == sandbox)) and (event.role == guest)
    then require label = allow

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when ((event.action == export) and (event.context == sandbox)) and (event.risk == FALSE)
    then require label = allow
